reason: An agent governance plugin that applies configurable tool-call policies, records structured audit events, and tracks token quotas across agents.

summaries.zh: 为智能体工具调用提供可配置的允许、拒绝或询问策略，并记录审计日志和管理令牌配额。
summaries.en: Provides configurable allow, deny, or ask policies for agent tool calls, structured audit logging, and token quota management.

capabilities: Policy-based allow, deny, or ask decisions for agent tool calls
Structured JSONL audit logging with query and export operations
Per-agent and global token quota tracking, configuration, and reset
Persistent governance state under the DSH home directory
